releaseTitle: TikSave v1.1.9 (360° Running Border Beam, Multi-Link Batch Saver & AMOLED Pro)
releaseNotes:
• NEW FEATURE (48H Spotlight): Multi-Link Batch Queue Saver — paste multiple TikTok links at once and auto-save all videos, photo slides, or 320kbps MP3s without watermarks
• Continuous 360° Running Border Light: Slow-motion 5-second electric cyan/blue perimeter beam with layered glassmorphic backdrop mask and crisp 60fps performance
• Refined High-Contrast AMOLED UI: Deep obsidian surfaces (#020409), vibrant gradient CTAs, and razor-sharp white typography optimized for low-end devices
• Original Production Keystore Preserved: Seamless in-app self-update signed with verified CN=TikSave certificate
